headline: Coding agents tightened sandboxes and MCP handling this week, and some defaults now behave differently.

themes.title: Sandboxes and MCP servers are locked down
themes.facts: Claude Code stopped sandboxed commands from changing the `--mcp-config` file ([2.1.309](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.309)); agy blocks `~/.docker`, `~/.kube` and `~/_netrc` in its sandbox unless you grant access ([1.4.6](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.4.6)); Kilo Code treats shell expressions in MCP prompts as plain text ([v7.8.16](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/releases/tag/v7.8.16)).
themes.so_what: any sandbox or MCP setup that worked by accident may now need an explicit grant.

themes.title: Plugins are checked before they load
themes.facts: `agy plugin validate --strict --json` uses the loader's own rules for CI ([1.4.0](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.4.0)), and 1.4.6 adds checks for context providers and for `SKILL.md` files the loader skips ([1.4.6](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.4.6)).
themes.so_what: if you write plugins for more than one agent, test them in each one's validator.

themes.title: Autonomy, with a guard in front
themes.facts: agy's Auto mode has a separate agent review commands that would leave the sandbox ([1.3.5](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.3.5)), and Claude Code added `/auto-mode-setup` to teach auto mode about your project ([2.1.304](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.304)).
themes.so_what: "approve every command" is ending; how good the safety check is becomes the real difference.

watch_next: Claude Code 2.1.309 changes `ultrareview` and `/rewind`, so expect reports of broken scripts. OpenCode 2 is still opt-in; the day a v2 release becomes "Latest" will be big news.
